Welcome to Snapgrove v1.7.42! 🚀

This patch brings major polish to gallery navigation, cursor ergonomics, and desktop workflow shortcuts.

### What's Changed
- **Material 3 Collapsing Header**: Folders with long names now get the full screen width when unscrolled instead of getting squished between action buttons. As you scroll down, the title collapses smoothly into the top bar with a compact font.
- **Material 3 Checkmark Switches**: Replaced the legacy toggle buttons with authentic Material 3 animated checkmark switches across Settings, Debug, and Gallery.
- **Desktop Shortcut Tooltips**: You can now hit `Esc` to go back, `f` for fullscreen, and `i` for image info on Windows and Web, with tooltips to guide you.
- **Clean Filename Truncation**: Filenames in delete and bin confirmation popups now truncate cleanly in the middle while preserving their file extensions (`screenshot_...123.png`), so dialogs stay neat and readable. (The Info dialog still shows the full, unabbreviated name!).
- **Universal Click Cursors**: Hovering over buttons, chips, and toggles on desktop and web now consistently gives you a hand pointer.
- **Debug Gating**: Debug tools are cleanly disabled by default for clean production builds.

Happy screenshot organizing! 🫡
